$comment: Stage I/O contract. Field entries: { type, note, optional?, from? }. `from` = '<stage>.out.<shape>' names the upstream shape a field is taken from verbatim; tests/contracts.tests.ps1 asserts every `from` resolves (subset relation). Nothing here is read by the crawler itself — it stamps; tests/crawler.tests.ps1 asserts the stamped descriptor equals out.file exactly.

RootPath.note: directory; resolved to absolute, forward-slash, trailing '/'

Graph.note: ordinal keys; root = ''. STRUCTURE ONLY — what contains what. Aggregates over it live in Rollups

Rollups.note: subtree aggregation — a SIBLING of Graph, like Skipped, not folded into it (ledger #52). A rollup is metadata ABOUT the graph, never a property OF a node; welding it on made membrane strip node fields to avoid shipping a pre-filter total on a post-filter node, and made the same aggregation at run scope (DirectoryCount / FileCount, already siblings here) look like a different kind of thing

DirectoryCount.note: NODE count over the structure, root included — equals Graph.Count. Not a rollup row: it happens to equal Rollups.ByNode[''].SubtreeDirCount + 1 because SubtreeDirCount counts descendants excluding self. Both relations asserted in crawler.tests — 'same number, both about the root' is exactly the adjacency that hides an off-by-self

FileCount.note: ungrouped file count over the walked slice — equals Rollups.ByNode[''].SubtreeFileCount because the root row's group IS the whole slice (an identity of the grouping, nothing to do with 'root' semantics); asserted in crawler.tests

Skipped.note: diagnostics feed — a SIBLING of Graph, not folded into it

node.$comment: STRUCTURE. A node says what it is and what it contains — nothing that is computed by walking its descendants. Subtree totals moved to out.rollups 2026-08-23 (ledger #52).

NodePath.note: graph key; directory portion, trailing '/', root = ''

Condition.note: THE LAYER'S IDENTITY — the named slice of data this rollup ran over (the WHERE). 'walked' = every file the crawl saw, before the membrane rejects any of it. The same aggregation conditioned on a different slice (survivors, discards, any predicate over the atoms) is another layer of this shape, keyed the same way — a consumer checks which slice it holds instead of trusting a field name, and no layer can impersonate another. Condition and grouping (ByNode) are independent axes; 'root' is on neither — ByNode[''] is merely the row whose group is the whole slice

ByNode.note: the GROUPING — same keys as Graph; join, never embed

SubtreeDirCount.note: descendants not counting self, within Condition's slice

SubtreeFileCount.note: files at or below, within Condition's slice

SubtreeBytes.note: sum of SizeBytes at or below, within Condition's slice — an aggregation over retained atoms, never a measurement (ledger #52)

RelativePath.note: root-anchored, forward slashes, no leading slash; = NodePath + name

NodePath.note: owning node key, duplicated so the descriptor stands alone after flattening

FsAttributes.note: System.IO.FileAttributes flags; not 'Attributes' (that is the rs-attributes element)

Reason.note: AttributeReadFailed | ReparsePoint | FileStatReadFailed | AccessDenied | PathTooLong | IOException | SecurityException | NotSupported | <exception type>
